effects.description: Scale change between geographic levels: country close-up -> whole world (or ocean-scale) in one fast move, with motion blur at the peak
effects.visual_purpose: tell the viewer where the next subject is relative to the last; reset attention
effects.animation_behavior: zoom out/in about the subject with exponential-in-out easing; peak speed in the middle; streak blur while fast
effects.timing: 0.3-0.5 s per move (4-6 frames at 12 fps in the 3.4-4.0 strip), hold 0.5-1.2 s on arrival
dependencies: camera motion blur (Scene does it above its speed threshold)
effects.preset: scale_change(t0, c0, h0, c1, h1, dur=1.4, pullback=1.12) / snap_zoom(dur=0.32)
qa_rules: camera.check: no window outside the image
anchor inside the safe frame at arrival
speed peak not on text
effects.uncertainty: ratios and exact easing are visual estimates from 2-12 fps strips; the reference uses a 3D globe/terrain basemap, here only image-space zooms exist (class A)

effects.description: Region flash: the subject territory is filled with a saturated colour (red, magenta) before anything else
effects.visual_purpose: instant 'this is the place' recognition; colour = attention, not data
effects.animation_behavior: fill appears at full strength for ~0.2 s then either stays flat or is replaced by a textured fill
effects.timing: fill on at the word, flat for 0.5-1.5 s
dependencies: a region MASK or polygon in the picture's pixel space (never guessed)
qa_rules: mask must come from data or a documented trace (source + validation text)
tint must not hide the evidence: settle alpha <= 0.2 on satellite pixels
effects.uncertainty: reference fills are fully opaque; OrbitalAtlas keeps satellite evidence visible, so alpha is lower by design

effects.description: Territory with a glowing outline (yellow/orange) and a waving flag texture inside
effects.animation_behavior: outline glows continuously; flag cloth ripples (animated shading)
effects.timing: continuous while the country is the subject
qa_rules: flag/cloth NOT built; do not claim it
effects.uncertainty: cloth animation and flag texture are NOT implemented; flags need original or public-domain artwork per ASSET_SOURCE_REGISTRY

effects.description: Name label in a thin white-bordered box with a vertical leader line to the subject, appearing with a short blur-in
effects.visual_purpose: named geography; anchors text to the place
effects.animation_behavior: box fades/blurs in over ~0.25 s, holds, leaves with the subject

parameters.box: 1-2 px white border, dark translucent fill (estimated)

qa_rules: label box registered in text.Registry (collision, outside-frame)
never cover the subject
effects.uncertainty: boxed label with leader exists in PulseMarker/Dubai code; a unified boxed-label overlay with blur-in is not built

effects.description: Curved route arrow between two places with a white shaft, an arrow head and a distance label that travels with it
effects.visual_purpose: show where one place is relative to another and how far
effects.animation_behavior: shaft draws on along a curve; head leads; label pops/tilts near the start then rides the path

parameters.head: triangle, accent colour (reference: violet; OrbitalAtlas: amber)

dependencies: distance computed from them (haversine) or sourced
effects.preset: RouteArrow(p0, p1, t0, dur, bend, label)
qa_rules: the label number must be derived from the anchors or a VERIFIED claim
validation text: presentation curve, not a measured route
effects.uncertainty: reference distances are not checked here; our arrow carries a validation string and is not a flight or shipping track

effects.description: Large distance numeral ('2600 km') rotated and perspective-skewed, motion-blurred, flying past before settling smaller on the arrow
effects.animation_behavior: text starts tilted about the vertical axis with perspective and heavy blur, settles flat
qa_rules: text must settle fully legible
box inside the frame at rest
effects.uncertainty: 2.5D by perspective transform of a flat raster; no depth sorting or lighting

effects.description: Several curved white/green lines radiate from one point across the map
effects.animation_behavior: lines draw on outward from the marker
qa_rules: lines must follow real geography if they claim routes
effects.uncertainty: no dedicated radial-burst preset; composition of existing overlays

effects.description: Red map pin that drops onto the location and settles
qa_rules: pin tip lands on the verified anchor (overlay-checked on the mosaic)
effects.uncertainty: pin art is our own simple shape

effects.description: Violet comet line travelling across the ocean with a fading tail
effects.animation_behavior: bright head with a tapering tail, eased
qa_rules: decor unless it encodes a real route
effects.uncertainty: colour is a design example only; OrbitalAtlas uses its own accents

effects.description: Localised colour transformation: the ocean region becomes a bright cyan block with a label that scales in ('Atlantic Ocean', 'Gulf of Guinea')
effects.visual_purpose: highlight a water body as a region
effects.animation_behavior: region recolour with a soft edge; label scales in from large to rest
effects.preset: RegionTint(color=CYAN) for annotation; grade.apply(preset, mask) for a PRESENTATION basemap only
qa_rules: never recolour EVIDENCE pixels: use the tint overlay (annotation) and say so
grade.Graded refuses strong presets on evidence
effects.uncertainty: the reference recolours a basemap (presentation); a recolour of real imagery would break the evidence rule

effects.description: Word-by-word bottom captions: white words, the currently spoken word in green, italic bold, black outline
effects.animation_behavior: active word colour changes at its timestamp; previous words stay
qa_rules: captions inside safe frame
never two cards at once
timing source recorded in the manifest
effects.uncertainty: reference uses green on the active word; our accent is amber/cyan

effects.description: Saturated cinematic satellite basemap: deep blue oceans, ochre/orange deserts, dark green forest, strong contrast
effects.visual_purpose: premium look for a map Short
qa_rules: EVIDENCE class limited to neutral/evidence_safe; manifest records evidence_pixels_unmodified
effects.uncertainty: estimates of saturation/contrast from compressed frames

effects.description: Short horizontal blur-in of labels and titles on entry
effects.animation_behavior: text arrives with blur resolving to sharp
qa_rules: final frame sharp
